trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Any shape; scalar or tensor containing at least one negative infinity value.
trigger_condition.value_trigger: torch.relu input equal to negative infinity, or large negative finite values that overflow to negative infinity under preceding ops such as torch.sinh.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input has at least one element that is -inf after a preceding op; model uses torch.relu under CPU Inductor.

bug_oracle.description: torch.compile CPU Inductor returns NaN for torch.relu(-inf) while eager returns 0, causing NaN location mismatch in comparisons.
bug_oracle.signal: AssertionError / nan location mismatch in assert_allclose(equal_nan=True)

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Inject or mutate floating point tensors to contain inf/-inf/NaN and finite values that overflow after activation functions.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CPU float32 tensors of varying shapes with elements set to -inf or large negative values that become -inf after torch.sinh/torch.exp.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force execution through torch.compile using backend='inductor' or mode='max-autotune'.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply preceding overflowable ops such as torch.sinh or torch.exp followed by torch.relu; also directly call torch.relu on special value tensors.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare compiled outputs against eager outputs using exact comparison or assert_allclose(equal_nan=True); flag any NaN/Inf location mismatch.
